description: The notes area (label hub): scopes, listing, searching, reading and writing notes that are not on the desktop, creating, renaming, deleting and restoring them, colors, putting a note on the desktop and taking it back, exporting through the backend's save dialog, showing a note or a notes folder in the file manager, copying a note through the backend, answering the backend's save requests, the settings, the tray texts, showing itself once loaded, listening to the backend's events. No core:window permission is granted, and no dialog or clipboard permission: those plugins are used from the backend only.
